# U109: Dates are picked: as Tunde on the measure step, Baseline and Target each sit beside a week, From “Week 45 · 2–8 Nov 2026 · This week” and To “Week 53 · 28 Dec 2026–3 Jan 2027 · The end of 2026”; opening To lists the three named weeks, then 2026 from week 46, and 2027; typing “14 Dec” chooses week 51; “The end of Q1 2027” closes as “Week 13 · 29 Mar–4 Apr 2027” and the line says it carries into 2027; the keyboard alone moves From to week 40, which asks whether it has been running since, and “No, start from this week” puts it back. Check reads “from 42 min in week 45 (2–8 Nov 2026) to 30 min by week 13 of 2027 (29 Mar–4 Apr 2027)”, and so does the published goal’s About. A stage’s Due is the same picker; no number field for a week is on the step

- Press the Enter key.
